title: Maria Is Sick
text:
Maria has a bad cold. She has a fever and a sore throat. She stays in bed for two days. Her mother gives her warm soup and water.

On the third day, Maria feels better. She still has a small cough. She goes to the doctor for a check-up. The doctor says she can go to school next week.

options: She must stay in bed for a month
She can go to school next week

questions.text: Why does Maria's mother give her warm soup?
options: Because she wants to go to school
To make her feel better when she is sick

questions.text: How does Maria feel on the third day?
options: Very happy because it is a holiday

vocabulary.definition: a body temperature that is higher than normal, often a sign of illness
a sudden noise you make when air is pushed out of your throat
a visit to a doctor to see if you are healthy
a piece of furniture where you sleep or rest

paragraph_translations: Maria'nın ağır bir nezlesi var. Ateşi ve boğaz ağrısı var. İki gün yatakta kalıyor. Annesi ona sıcak çorba ve su veriyor.
Üçüncü gün Maria kendini daha iyi hissediyor. Hâlâ küçük bir öksürüğü var. Kontrol için doktora gidiyor. Doktor, gelecek hafta okula gidebileceğini söylüyor.
